name: a2a-mod
description: A2A protocol client for Claude Code: Claude hands tasks to non-Claude worker agents over Agent2Agent and picks up their results. LAN mode: Claude Code sessions on the same network find each other and exchange messages and files.

layout.title: A2A layout
layout.description: full: cards, band and workers pane. pane: the workers pane only. minimal: the status line only.

animations.title: A2A animations
animations.description: Off: spinners, shimmer, bars and the wire draw one still frame.

tokens.title: Worker tokens
tokens.description: alias=token pairs separated by spaces, e.g. "w1=abc w2=def"

lanSecret.title: LAN shared secret
lanSecret.description: LAN mode: the same secret (8+ characters) on every machine whose Claude Code sessions should see each other. Empty: LAN mode is off.

lanName.title: LAN name
lanName.description: LAN mode: the name other sessions address this one by (lan:<name>). Empty: <hostname>/<folder>.
